'''Vastrip IV''' was a celestial body<ref name="WbC">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref> located in the [[Vastrip system/Legends|Vastrip system]], a part of the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Lar Maendin]] was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] at Vastrip IV<ref name="WbC" /> in [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]],<ref name="MaendinDate">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']] is dated to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates that engagement to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the placement of the sourcebook therefore translates to [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]. Furthermore, since ''Wanted by Cracken'' states that [[Lar Maendin]] is age 30, he must have been [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] in [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]].</ref> a fact that was noted<ref name="WbC" /> in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]<ref name="MaendinDate" /> by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] in ''[[Wanted by Cracken]]'', a [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] that served as a compilation of reports on various threats to the New Republic.<ref name="WbC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vastrip IV was mentioned in the [[1993]] sourcebook [[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']], which was written by [[Louis J. Prosperi]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="WbC" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Vastrip [[Star system/Legends|system]], and thereby Vastrip IV, in grid square N-7.<ref name="TEA" />
